# U184: Trusting the number in a review: as Amara, the Reliability weekly’s agenda shows under Change failure rate “Change failure rate · Verified … · Refreshed …”, and under Mean time to detect “Draft metric” with the warning mark, never a status shape and nothing to change; Mean time to detect’s page says what it still needs, never “Fully defined”; To sort out keeps each name readable; adding “Deploy frequency” from the DORA dashboard, meaning the same thing, shows the similar Verified metric as a card, and Use this one opens it

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-STAGE`, `METRIC-DEFINED`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/reviews/reliability` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U184
